# Learning

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-skill-metadata.py from SKILL.md frontmatter. -->

- **[break-it](./break-it/SKILL.md)** — Use to learn a system-design or performance concept by watching the naive version break under load and the pattern hold — "break it", "load test this", "where does this fall over", "/break-it &lt;concept&gt;". Builds a disposable Go+k6 lab; the user predicts the breaking point, runs it, sees the wall, applies the fix, re-runs. Load-measurable concepts only (pool exhaustion, missing cache, N+1, no rate limiting, no backpressure, no circuit breaker). NOT for refactoring or terminology — those are untangle / name-it.
- **[lab](./lab/SKILL.md)** — Create one standalone coding exercise with learner files and executable unit tests. Use when the user asks for a coding lab, hands-on programming exercise, test-driven practice, or selects the lab modality in /learn. Conceptual and written-response exercises are out of scope.
